findings.passage: Mike will stand against efforts to compromise Georgia’s new Election Integrity Act. The new legislation makes it  easier to vote and harder to cheat. Photo ID, secure election drop boxes and expanded early voting, including weekends, will ensure a fair election process.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, undated; the site's home page refers to a June 21 run-off, so it appears to be his 2022 campaign. It names SB 202 (the Election Integrity Act), photo ID, drop boxes and early voting as features of a fair process.

findings.passage: We also achieved a major win for Georgia voters with the passage of Senate Bill 3EX. The legislation creates the Election Equipment Specification and Standards Committee, which will evaluate and recommend new election equipment designed for hand-marked paper ballots.
findings.note: His column from the 2026 special session describes SB 3EX (election equipment committee for hand-marked paper ballots; manual recount rule). It does not address ID or citizenship. Saved as related election-administration material.
